ctx.x: got to find out what was happening, and I got discouraged there. I figured I'd go to California to see what was happening. So I got on a train, and me and another cat named Hill, Frank Hill I think his name was, we got on a...hoboed on a train to go to California. And the train stopped right outside of Amarillo [SOUNDS LIKE 'Camarillo.'] And the brakeman saw us on the train and put us off, you know. He said, "You ain't got no business being on this," you know, so forth and so on. Anyway, we...
